title: Join the OpenDesign AI Prototype Hackathon
body:
Build beyond the chatbox: Use OpenDesign to create a complete, clickable AI product experience between September 9–18.
Create and share: Enter solo or with a team of up to five, record a 30–90 second demo, publish it on X, and submit your project to the community.
Win OpenDesign credits: The top three projects will receive US$1,000, US$600, and US$200. The first 50 participants with a valid submission will also receive US$5 each.

zh-CN.title: 参加 OpenDesign AI 原型黑客松
zh-CN.body:
突破聊天框：9 月 9 日—18 日，使用 OpenDesign 打造一款完整、可点击的 AI 产品原型。
创作并分享：单人或组队均可！录制一段 30—90 秒的 Demo，发布到 X，并在discord或飞书提交作品。
赢取 OpenDesign Credit：前三名将分别获得 US$1,000、US$600 和 US$200。前 50 位完成有效投稿的参赛者，每人还可获得 US$5。
